relations.subject: A. A. Macdonell
relations.evidence: I offered as a dissertation for the degree of Ph. D. in the University of Leipzig, at Easter 1884.

relations.subject: A. A. Macdonell
relations.evidence: To his guidance in my Sanskrit studies I owe so much, that although I never attended any of his lectures... I cannot but look upon myself as a pupil of his in the real sense of the word.
